title: Overzichtskaart van het Eiland Alor – blad

series.title: Overzichtskaart van het Eiland Alor
series.notes: Map of Alor Island showing villages, sparsely inhabited regions, coconut trees, undergrowths, forests, grasses, palms, wetlands, unpaved roads, horse tracks, footpaths, rivers, lakes, stones, Christian cemeteries, Chinese and native graves, missions, and landscape borders. Relief shown by contours, and spot heights. | "(Vluchtig opgenomen door den Topografische dienst in 1927-1928)" | Includes leaf classification index, text, abbreviations, administrative division index, and legend.

creator: Netherlands. Topografische Dienst
